## Invitations

The outreach activity recorded 1427 invitations during the reporting period. Of those invited, 257 people attended. This represents an attendance rate of 18.0 per cent. The result provides a summary of participation among those contacted and invited to attend.

Van days were kept where roads allowed. This supported access to the outreach activity in areas affected by local road conditions and helped maintain the planned contact arrangements. Attendance figures should be considered alongside the practical limitations affecting travel and access.

## Contact

SMS messages were sent to 1230 invitees. Reminders were also sent to 1230 invitees, providing a consistent follow-up approach for those contacted before the activity. The use of SMS and reminders supported communication with invitees and reinforced the arrangements for attendance.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
